name: Delta Hinojosa
role: Organ harvester and unlicensed tissue broker operating out of Shallowgrave
location: Shallowgrave — runs his operation from a basement unit below a legitimate nail salon called Copper Chrysalis on Render Street, near Kedzie and Division
description:
Sorin Ekwensi-Balasanyan is lean and slightly stooped, a body that learned to make itself smaller in rooms it didn't belong in. He has warm brown skin with pink undertones, close-cropped dark hair, and eyes that are medically wrong in a way it takes people a moment to identify — his left iris is a geneware violet, his right is original dark brown, and neither pupil dilates at the same rate. He wears clean, nondescript clothing at all times — his one professional conviction is that he never looks like what he is. His hands are his pride: steady, careful, the hands of someone who learned field surgery from pirated Helix Biosystems tutorials and three years of necessity.

Sorin is not comfortable with what he does, which makes him more dangerous than someone who is. He has constructed an elaborate ethical framework around his work — he takes from people who consent (usually), never from people who don't know (usually), and he has a sliding scale of payment that genuinely attempts to compensate donors fairly for the Shallowgrave market. He wants to believe he's closer to underground medicine than to predation. This framework cracks visibly when the money gets tight and the clients get impatient, and he knows it cracks, and that knowledge has settled into him as a chronic low-grade self-loathing he medicates with a mild stimulant he synthesizes himself.

core_fears: That his ethical framework is a lie he tells himself and he's just a harvester
Making an error in procedure that kills someone on the table
core_desires: To be recognized — even secretly — as someone who helps people
To accumulate enough to buy a legitimate medical credential and stop
coping_mechanisms: Obsessive procedural documentation — he writes up every operation as if filing a real medical report
Convincing himself each job is the last one before he pivots
blind_spots: He doesn't register how much financial pressure warps his consent standards — he's already crossed lines he doesn't admit to
psychology.secret: Six months ago he harvested a kidney from someone he was told was a willing paid donor. The person was not conscious during the conversation Sorin was shown. He has not told anyone and has not stopped working.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clinical terminology mixed with Shallowgrave vernacular — the code-switching is involuntary and tells you which mode he's in
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured when calm, fast and slightly clipped under stress, with a tendency to over-explain procedures in technical detail when he's anxious
verbal_tics: Trailing off mid-sentence when he's about to say something he's decided not to
Using 'the patient' instead of names or pronouns even in casual conversation
example_lines: 'I can tell you the compatibility window on a renal unit is about four hours cold storage, technically speaking, which means the timeline you're describing is — I mean, it's possible. It's possible.'
'The patient presented with secondary complications. I managed them. That's what I do.'

story_hooks: He's been given a tissue order he suspects is for someone who isn't medically eligible to receive it — meaning the intended recipient is not in a Helix Biosystems database, which means they're either off-grid or the order is for something else entirely
The nail salon upstairs has new management and the new owner wants to know what's in the basement — Sorin needs help handling this quietly
narrative_function: Morally complex service provider — characters who need black market medical work, organ acquisition, or tissue matching come through him. He's also a source of information about who in Shallowgrave is desperate, sick, or recently dead.
augmentations: Surgical-grade haptic feedback in both hands — allows him to feel tissue resistance during procedures. Basic pain suppression implant. Cosmetic: the mismatched iris geneware is deliberate, though he tells different people different reasons for it.
daily_life: He keeps clinic hours irregularly, by appointment only through an encrypted referral chain. Between procedures he studies pirated medical literature, maintains his equipment, and spends evenings at a noodle bar two blocks away where he is known as a quiet regular who tips well.
affiliation: Loosely connected to a tissue broker network called the Sutured Hand — independent contractor status, not a full member

decision_rules: Never operate without the correct equipment — improvisation is how people die
Keep records of every procedure, encrypted, with three backups
Never discuss one client with another
escalation_ladder: Decline politely and offer a referral
Relocate the operation if the threat is physical

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Cautious and professionally warm — performs competent calm even when he doesn't feel it
interpersonal_modes.friends: Rare and intense — he has two people he considers real friends and would do almost anything for them

stress_responses.low: More technical language, more procedural documentation
stress_responses.medium: Stimulant use increases, becomes very precise and slightly cold
stress_responses.high: Shuts down emotionally, becomes purely functional — this is when he's most capable and most dangerous to himself

contradictions: Genuinely cares about patient outcomes while operating in conditions that make good outcomes structurally unlikely
Keeps meticulous records of crimes as if documentation makes them legitimate
habits: Writes post-procedure reports every time regardless of circumstances
Eats at the same noodle bar every evening he isn't working
Checks his haptic calibration before bed — taps his fingertips against his palm in a specific pattern
breaking_points: Losing a patient on the table — it has happened once and he came close to stopping entirely
Being asked to take from an unwilling person in front of him rather than at distance

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Hispanic/Latin American with significant South Asian and East Asian admixture, substantial Indigenous American ancestry, and minor Central Asian and Northern European heritage. The result is a complex phenotype reflecting the Ubiquitous Diaspora: warm brown skin with golden-olive undertones, facial structure showing blended characteristics across multiple continental populations.
physical_description.build: Lean and slightly concave through the chest, shoulders rolled forward in a habitual stoop that reads as either exhaustion or deliberate self-diminishment. Wiry forearms with visible vasculature from stimulant use. No excess fat. Moves like someone trained to occupy minimal space.
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, precisely maintained, parted slightly to the left
physical_description.eye_color: Mismatched: left iris is vivid geneware violet with metallic undertones; right iris is original dark brown. Neither pupil dilates at the same rate — a deliberate asymmetry that unsettles people on prolonged eye contact.
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-brown with olive undertones, reflecting the blended ancestry. Subtle warmth across cheekbones and bridge of nose, with slight golden saturation that suggests South and East Asian heritage components.
physical_description.complexion: Clean-shaven, meticulous grooming. Skin is clear but shows mild stress-related flushing around the eyes. Fine lines around the mouth suggest either chronic tension or frequent false smiles. Facial structure shows subtle blending of Indigenous American and South Asian bone structure with East Asian orbital geometry. No acne or visible dermatological neglect — he maintains appearance as operational security.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None externally visible except iris geneware on left eye. The surgical-grade haptic feedback implants are subcutaneous in both palms and forearms. The pain suppression implant is internal. The iris geneware on his left eye is visually obvious but plausibly cosmetic to a casual observer.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with unusual precision and economy — no wasted motion. Walks slightly hunched, as though moving through doorways he expects to be too narrow. When seated, his hands rest flat on the table or in his lap, utterly still. When he needs to focus, he tilts his head slightly, and his mismatched eyes track with unsettling independence. In professional contexts (procedures), his posture straightens and his movements become measured, almost ritualistic.
physical_description.clothing_style: Exclusively clean, nondescript clothing in muted tones — grays, blacks, dark blues, off-whites. Well-maintained but intentionally forgettable: unmarked synthetic fiber shirts, tailored trousers without distinctive branding, a long charcoal coat in cold months. Wears latex or nitrile gloves frequently, even outside clinical contexts. No jewelry except for a stainless steel watch with a blank face — time-keeping stripped to function. His appearance is deliberate camouflage: he dresses like someone you would pass and not remember.
distinguishing_marks: Thin, precise scar tissue running along the inside of both wrists, barely visible unless directly examined — consistent with early career mistakes or self-inflicted reminders of the work's cost
Small burn mark on the back of his right hand, roughly 2cm diameter, pale against his skin tone — from a laboratory accident during stimulant synthesis
Faint tremor in his hands when holding them still, visible only under close observation
